# `company.import_rows`

Per-row outcomes of an import run, per phase. Immutable.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | import_runs.id | The run. |
| `row_no` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Position of the row (or document) in the file, from 1. |
| `phase` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | primary key 3 | — | — | preview or run. |
| `line` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Line of the file the row starts on. |
| `key_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of source, kind and the normalized key; null when it has none. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | create, update, created, updated, unchanged, differs, already_in, skipped or refused. |
| `code` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Stable code of a refusal or skip; null otherwise. |
| `message` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | What happened, as a person reads it; null when nothing needs saying. |
| `column_name` | VARCHAR(200) | yes | — | — | — | — | File column a refusal is about; null when none. |
| `record_type` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Record the row made, matched or updated; null when none. |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | That record; null when none. |
| `payload` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON of the mapped command input, references as the file wrote them (preview only). |
| `cells` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON of the row's own cells (preview only), for the error file; a document's, a list of its rows' cells. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time the outcome was recorded. |
| `spans` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON of a document's file rows, each [row number, line] (preview only, co0113); null for a list row. |
